title: rhode makes European retail debut at Sephora in 19 countries
summary: Previously available in Europe exclusively through rhodeskin.com, the brand founded by Hailey Rhode Bieber and acquired by e.l.f. Beauty last year will now be sold in more than 500 Sephora stores across the region, starting September 30, 2026.
